note: Small upland and creek-bottom area on Troublesome Creek northeast of Emerson. MDC's two primitive camping spots sit beside the two small gravel lots along the area's gravel lane, one at a bend and one at the turnaround at the lane's end; no amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: two map-designated primitive camping spots, each beside a gravel lot on the area's one gravel lane (GIS 198 by lot 97 = the pin; GIS 197 by lot 96 at the turnaround, 160 m N). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin fine; phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey) | Designated Camping Sites'; the area map (© 06/08) has two 'Primitive Camping Area' symbols, each beside a parking lot on the gravel road in from CR 137; GIS 27 points 197 and 198 'Primitive Camping Area'. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN fine: stored 39.90678,-91.67931 = GIS 198, 17 m from gravel lot 97 (39.90667,-91.67945), a small pull-off where the lane bends. The other spot (GIS 197, 39.90821,-91.67873) is 166 m N beside lot 96 at the lane's turnaround loop. The gravel lane is wide and graded on imagery; a 23-ft rig reaches both. No ford or posted limit. Same lane and entrance - no split.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Troublesome Creek (a narrow creek) passes ~50-60 m NE of the north spot through a wooded strip; the south spot is ~200 m from it. No open apron or view.
HORSES: none named. CLUSTERS: two spots 166 m apart on one lane.
